doc: Wave 1 census - the unified media element build manifest.

sgs/media.notes: First surface wired. Hand-rolls its own tier cascade past sgs_tier_media_render() via a closure taking (modifier_base, tiers_present) with the uid CLOSED OVER, against the shared helper (present, base_class, uid). The bodies are near-identical; only the argument order and one whitespace difference in the @media text diverge.

does_better: ONE parameterised MediaSlotPicker + sgs_before_after_resolve_media() drives both slots - zero drift between before/after (M4 S1).
Narrowest per-type gating of any surface: every type-specific control is wrapped in an exact equality check (M4 S2).
Emits custom-property VALUES so a scoped <style> never has two writers - a real extension of Spec 32 beyond inline style="" (M4 S5).
sgs/before-after.notes: THE FALSIFYING SECOND SURFACE. Video and SVG sides are confirmed FLAT - no tier attrs, no tier controls, no tier resolver branches. Only the image side has tiers.

sgs/hero.notes: TWO media families on one block (split-media + background). One of only two adopters of sgs_tier_media_render(), alongside timeline.

sgs/container.notes: BackgroundPanel is shared by 8 host blocks, so a change here reaches all 8. No media-type enum exists: image, video and svg are three parallel families switched by an editor-only TabPanel, and at render VIDEO SILENTLY BEATS IMAGE with no editor warning (M3 S1).

sgs/decorative-image.notes: NAKED MODE: the IS the block root, so tier toggles are COMPOUND selectors, never descendant - there is no ancestor to descend from. This already forced a second conditional rendering shape to accommodate ONE shared JS module that assumed a wrapper existed (M5 S3).

sgs/product-card.notes: Content migration ships SEPARATELY, after the abstraction is proven. Stores a bare URL with no attachment ID at all, and in bound mode the attr OVERRIDES live WooCommerce data only when explicitly set (M5 S5).

excluded.sgs/responsive-logo: Bean's call. Already good - native <picture><source media>, zero JS, genuinely per-tier with inherit-up. Forcing it onto the shared shape is a DOWNGRADE, and excluding it removes a whole mechanism variant from v1.
excluded.sgs/info-box: Not a media surface. Its mediaType/image/icon are DEAD legacy attrs from before the FR-22-6 InnerBlocks migration; the real media lives in sgs/icon and sgs/media children (M5 S1).
excluded.sgs/image-sequence: Agency-only (inserter:false, needs a Python/ffmpeg CLI no client can run). Its "media" is a canvas frame rig with a fail-open thumbnail, not a displayed image (M5 S4).

presentation.doc: The PRESENTATION half of the manifest — media atoms 7-10 (object-fit / focal-point / box-shape / overlay). The Wave 1 census above is SOURCE-SIDE ONLY; see this script`s docstring.
presentation.reading_instruction: GAP ANALYSIS, not a wiring manifest. A name missing from a surface is an accidental gap, not a deliberate exclusion. `gaps` is the operative output; `surfaces` is only what exists today.

traps.truth: Only on sgs/media and sgs/before-after. On hero, container and product-card it is the WRAPPER max-width, paired with `contentWidth` and owned by SGS_Container_Wrapper.
traps.how_found: The two surfaces that own it as media have no `contentWidth` attribute at all; the three that do not, do.

traps.truth: sgs/media declares `integer` (intrinsic, paired with imageWidth, written from the chosen media -- atom 5). sgs/product-card declares `string` ("180px", client-facing box-shape control). A helper keyed on the name alone breaks one of them.
traps.how_found: Reading the declared type per surface rather than matching the name.

traps.truth: They are absolute placement of the decoration on its section. Folding them into atom 8 would move the wrong thing.
traps.how_found: Both are tier OBJECTS defaulting to {desktop:50} -- a percentage placement pair, not an object-position value.

disagreements.what: THREE rival enums for one property

detail.canonical-5: cover, contain, fill, none, scale-down (MediaSizingPanel, sgs/media, helpers-media-position.php)
detail.hero-4: cover, contain, fill, custom -- no none, no scale-down, and `custom` is a sizing mode. hero declares NO enum so it round-trips.
detail.backdrop-3: cover, contain, auto (backgroundSize on hero + container)

disagreements.resolution: D909 -- atom 7 is the canonical five and READS the others. `custom` is reassigned to atom 9 (box-shape).

disagreements.what: TWO storage shapes for one value
disagreements.resolution: Already bridged -- FocalPositionField takes a `format` prop ("xy" | "css-string") and src/utils/objectPosition.js converts. No new mechanism needed; coverage is the gap.

disagreements.what: Ratio format diverges, and height is modelled four ways
disagreements.resolution: OPEN -- atom 9 must pick one ratio format and read both.

disagreements.what: THREE implementations, one bypassing the shared emitter

detail.hero-bypass: mediaOverlayColour / mediaOverlayGradient -- calls neither, and has no opacity, blend mode, hover or tiers

disagreements.resolution: OPEN -- routing hero`s split overlay through the shared emitter is the cheap win.

disagreements.what: Inconsistent naming INSIDE one attribute family
disagreements.resolution: Recorded, not fixed -- a rename is a stored-post_content migration (D338). Atom 10 reads both.

decorative-image.positionX: Absolute placement of the decoration on the page — not the position of an object within its container. Never atom 8.
decorative-image.positionY: Absolute placement of the decoration on the page — not the position of an object within its container. Never atom 8.

maxWidth.note: Bounds the media box -- sgs/media has no contentWidth.
Bounds the media box -- no contentWidth on this block.

splitMediaObjectFit.note: Declares NO enum, and carries a 4th value "custom" that is a SIZING MODE (explicit width/height), not a CSS fit value -- render.php:625 gates object-fit OFF for it. Reassigned to box-shape (D909).

splitMediaObjectPosition.note: The only per-tier focal point in the population. Mobile defaults to "center 20%", Tablet to "".

mediaOverlayColour.note: Split-column overlay, SEPARATE from the section overlay. Bypasses sgs_overlay_decls() -- no opacity, no blend mode, no hover, no tiers.

backgroundSize.note: The backdrop equivalent of object-fit, and NOT equivalent in vocabulary: cover/contain/auto only. class-sgs-container-wrapper.php:1106-1108 records the impedance mismatch in its own comment.

width.note: Naked mode -- sgs_responsive_image() emits the AS the block root, so there is no ancestor to descend from. positionX/positionY on this block are ABSOLUTE PLACEMENT, not focal point. Trap 3.

imageHeight.note: string "180px", client-facing, drives --sgs-product-card-image-height. NOT the same concept as sgs/media imageHeight. Non-responsive. Trap 2.
